end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes using melting ghee, ice cream, butter and wax, focusing on no new substance and reversibility. They also discussed rusting, burning a candle, dissolving sugar and cooking dough as chemical changes. They correctly separated melting wax from burning wax by the end; teach-back of the physical-change definition was not yet complete. At home, ask Ananya to classify three everyday changes and explain whether a new substance forms.
